_comment: Auto-compaction policy, applied by install.sh and checked by bin/pi-setup-doctor.
Both read this file so the rule lives in one place.
Pi compacts when contextTokens > contextWindow - reserveTokens, but it only evaluates
that after an agent run finishes (_checkCompaction is reached from _handlePostAgentRun,
after `await this.agent.prompt(...)` returns). Everything inside one run accumulates
unchecked, so the reserve has to absorb an entire run, not just the next reply. Pi's
default of 16384 assumes the check runs often.
Measured on session 019fb8da (2026-07-31, gpt-5.6-sol, 272000-token window): the
threshold was crossed at 265232 tokens and the run kept going for 64 more model calls,
peaking at 290536 - 18536 tokens past the window. reserveTokens 45000 compacts at 227000,
which would have covered the ~25000 that run added after crossing.
IMPORTANT: this is slack, not a bound. A long enough run passes any threshold. On
2026-08-03, with 45000 already applied, a run on mk reached 120.5% of the window (~328000
tokens). No setting here prevents that, and no extension can either - ctx.compact()
aborts the agent. Only ending the run lets compaction happen. See docs/LONG_RUNS.md.
maxFractionOfWindow keeps the reserve away from bin/pi-setup-doctor's upper guard (half
the window) on small-context models, where a flat 45000 would leave too little usable
context. minReserveTokens is Pi's own default, the floor this never goes below.
